title: This East Bay arcade and laser tag spot is building a reputation for a sneaky good food - NewsBreak
text:
8 hours ago On Foothill Boulevard in Castro Valley, Sector 19 stands as a story of resilience, family, and second chances. The arcade and laser tag facitlity that includes an on-site restaurant first opened its doors in March 2020—the very week the pandemic shut much of the country down. What began as an effort to help a friend realize his dream quickly turned into a personal journey for owner Jacy Wong, who stepped in to save the business after it faltered. With the help of his brother Terry, a seasoned entrepreneur known for his longtime creamery (and even a feature on Man vs. Food ), the two have worked tirelessly to transform Sector 19 into a place where families can gather, share a meal, and make memories together.
Photo by Sector 19 The name “Sector 19” may not have been the original plan—Jacy first wanted to call the spot “Sector 7G,” a nod to Homer Simpson’s workplace—but copyright issues forced a pivot. What stayed constant was the vision: a family-friendly restaurant where good food and good times come first. “Our main goal is to ensure families have a memorable experience and serve them food that they actually enjoy,” Jacy explains.
Photo by Rachel Carey Running a restaurant, especially one born just as the pandemic reshaped the dining world, has been far from easy. Margins are thin, and costs stack up quickly—rent, insurance, taxes, salaries, and everything in between. Competing with street vendors who don’t shoulder the same overhead can make prices look out of balance, but Jacy is quick to point out the difference: Sector 19 is about the full experience, not just the plate of food.
Photo by I'm Still Hangry And it’s the families who make it worthwhile. “Seeing families have a good time and the excitement in the faces of the kids,” Jacy says, is the most rewarding part of all the effort. For him, the joy isn’t just in serving meals—it’s in creating moments that stick, the kind that bring people back time and again.
For now, the goal is simple: to keep building Sector 19 into a sustainable, welcoming neighborhood spot, and eventually to break even on the cost of keeping the dream alive. In the meantime, Jacy and Terry continue to pour their energy into making Sector 19 a place where people feel cared for, whether they’re stopping by for a casual meal or a special family outing.
Photo by Jorge Rivera It’s a story that began with unexpected challenges but has grown into something rooted in persistence, loyalty, and community. At Sector 19, you don’t just order food—you share in the spirit of a family that refused to give up.
Sector 19
📍 22380 Foothill Blvd, Castro Valley, CA
👨‍🍳 Owner: Jacy Wong (with brother Terry Wong)
🍴 Opened: March 2020
⭐ Mission: Great food, family-friendly atmosphere, and memories that last
